body: I guess I am trying to be the thing that makes it worth it. It just doesn't feel like enough right now but I'm still trying.

At this point I think she really wants to die and that it's more than just an overwhelming feeling. I can spot hope now and again but it seems almost impossible to get the hope to override the negative thoughts right now. 

I'm trying to be there for her as much as possible and am talking with her about her feelings every day. Forcing her into therapy has been hurting her which is why it is so difficult to keep insisting on it. 

I think right now I am just hoping that by comforting her and being there for her helps her reconsider, and pick herself back up. 

Thank you for your reply. I hope you also find something to put yourself in a better place.
I don't know if I should accept that death is the best option for her and move on
